summary: Get ready to return to the world of Brain Test with a long and tricky adventure!
description:
➤Join Alyx on her quest to find the six power gems in order to save her dying father. While helping Alyx to overcome tricky and brain teasing puzzles, meet with Brain Test franchise characters along the way.

➤Brain Test is an addictive free tricky brain puzzle game with a series of tricky brain teasers for a relaxing brain out. These offline mind games, brain games, IQ tests, thinking games and puzzle games are perfect for those who love a good brain workout.

➤Do you have the puzzle skills to solve the trickiest riddles ever? Are you capable of finding clues and using your mind for logical puzzles? Only the highly intelligent players can complete Brain Test 3’s difficult story and become a brain teaser master. Exercise your brain out with different tricky puzzles. This game is a new game and an offline game. Also one of the best games in the world. If you like puzzle games and mind games then dive into mind blowing riddles and brain teasers that make this brain puzzle game the ultimate free brain game for adults.

⭐A Long Story Filled with Adventure and Puzzles⭐
➤Brain Test 3 reshapes the successful formula of Brain Test 1: Tricky Puzzles and Brain Test 2: Tricky Stories and Brain Test 4: Tricky Stories to combine tricky riddles with an exciting and epic story. Join Alyx as she embarks on an adventure filled with dangers and troubles. Find the gems to achieve infinite power and write your name into the hall of fame. Brain games and iq games are for improving the brain. Challenge your mind with brain teasers, and brain out puzzles in this mind game! You can play the best offline games for free.

⭐Inventory System and Interactive Elements⭐
➤Brain Test has never been as interactive as it is now as you can collect objects into your inventory and use them to solve the tricky puzzles for relaxing brain out.You can also merge the objects in the inventory to create new items to pass tricky brain teasing obstacles. The inventory becomes a powerful toolset for the high IQ players. No riddles will be left unsolved.

⭐Improved Hint and Help Systems⭐
➤IQ games, brain games, and mind games can be a great way to enhance your mental abilities. To help with the more complex riddles and puzzles, we implemented a better hint system to the game. With the new help system, you are not forced to struggle with difficult puzzles and riddles. With easy game mechanics and tricky quests, this mind game offers an offline brain out challenge.

⭐Dialogue and Chat Levels⭐
➤Alyx will meet dozens of characters in the course of her long and epic adventure. These characters will require you to convince them with the correct chat responses. Like a true role playing game, you will enter into deep and complex dialogues with NPCs. Their responses will trick you and test your brain power as well as your social skills.

⭐Build a Workshop⭐
➤Brain Test 3 introduces a complex building system as you will build Alyx’s workshop and gradually develop it. There are idle resource generators which will help you in your tricky adventures. The workshop is filled with epic tools and machines for you to discover.

FEATURES:
* Tricky & Mind-blowing brain teasers and brain go: You will be tricked.
* Reverse logic puzzles.
* Mysterious riddles and puzzles.
* Intricate dialogue and chat systems.
* Role playing options.
* Offline mind game & easy game for brain training.
* Simple and addictive gameplay.
* Fan-favorite Brain Test art style with animated characters.
* Story-oriented gameplay.
* Customization options with lots of costumes, pets and workshop improvements.
* Can be played with one hand.
* Can be played offline and without the internet.
* Completely free to download and free to play.
* One of the best free games. 
* Comes from a franchise that tops the charts in brain games, adult puzzle games, and new games.

➤It is time to ready up your brain for an extremely tricky adventure filled with crazy riddles and puzzles! Download now and help Alyx to save her father!
